rules.logic: ABIOC(Post-Consent OAuth Token High-Volume Bulk API Export Deviating from Integration Baseline) AND ABIOC(Export-Then-Erase Bulk API Query Job Deletion by Exfiltration Token) observed within 30 minutes on the same connected_app and integration_user — fuses the high-volume Bulk API export anomaly and the export-then-erase query-job deletion into a single post-consent OAuth-token-abuse incident anchored to the compromised integration identity (trusted token -> mass CRM export -> job deletion), where no consent, MFA, or interactive login event exists to alert on.
rules.name: Post-Consent OAuth Token Abuse — Salesforce Export-Then-Erase Stitch
